notes:
- Scanning a reel that is already in the store says so: who put it in, when and on which cart, so it is not counted twice
- Another reel of the same lot can still go in, with its own button
- Yageo DataMatrix labels are read (31P, 30P, 32P, lot, quantity), also as USB scanners type them
- Scans that come in with shift held or in the wrong case are put right
- Electrolytic capacitors such as JKM470M2WBKAM25 read as "Electrolytic capacitor 47µF 450V"
